title: The rocket destroyed by one number

captions.text: In 1996, a brand-new rocket broke apart
captions.say: In nineteen ninety-six, a brand-new rocket broke apart

captions.text: about *forty seconds* after launch, because of !one number.!

captions.say: Ariane five's guidance software was reused

captions.text: was a *64-bit float* converted into a !16-bit integer.!
captions.say: was a sixty-four-bit float converted into a sixteen-bit integer.

captions.text: The biggest number that fits is !32,767.!
captions.say: The biggest number that fits is thirty-two thousand, seven hundred sixty-seven.

captions.text: Ariane 5 flew *faster,* the value got !too big,!
captions.say: Ariane five flew faster, the value got too big,

captions.text: Its *backup computer* ran the same code,
and had !failed the same way! moments earlier.
Follow: tomorrow, 60 FPS that still stutters.
captions.say: Follow. Tomorrow: sixty F P S that still stutters.
